shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && git ls-files | head -50
cat index.html src/*.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; ls -R __agent_eval__ | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '; echo; sed -n 1,80p build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts | head -100; cat build/esm/components/Avatar/Avatar.d.ts | head -60

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Avatar/types/main.d.ts | head -40; ls layout; grep -n "filterable\|errorMessage\|validationState\|name?" Select/types.d.ts; grep -n "validationState\|errorMessage\|errorPlacement\|hasClear" controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts controls/types.d.ts | head -20; grep -n "content\|description" Switch/Switch.d.ts Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head

grep -n " id?\|'id'\|name?" Select/types.d.ts controls/types.d.ts controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts; cat Avatar/../AvatarImage/AvatarImage.d.ts | head -20; grep -n "onUpdate\|checked" Switch/Switch.d.ts Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts; grep -n "Props = \|gap\|direction" layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head
